task.title: Bound functional Management BFF read latency and payload cost

owned_layer: Management BFF Cockpit composition and its shared alerts/runtime-health projections.
Management operations read-model composition for an individually requested persona.
Bounded async adaptation of the Source Ingest connector-registry read used by the Management data-sources surface.
Focused functional read-budget regressions and closure evidence.
not_changing: Source Ingest connector-registry ownership, refresh policy, persistence, or provider egress.
ReadSurfaceStore's role as a read adapter, existing Management API schema, frontend behavior, or pagination contract.
A general cache, cache invalidation authority, background refresh worker, load-test program, or live-capital path.
composes_with: PFG-MGMT-AI-PROVIDER-20260820 bounded Management BFF read conventions.
Existing MGMT-LOAD-005 bounded synchronous-read isolation contract.

cockpit.before: Cockpit built alerts and runtime health, then Operator Home built both projections again.
cockpit.after: Cockpit passes its one completed alerts and runtime-health projection into Operator Home.

operations_persona.before: A request for one persona built the 500-row Persona Fleet list and selected its row.
operations_persona.after: The request uses the requested canonical persona plus its direct persona-league entry; it never invokes the full-fleet builder.
operations_persona.regression: test_operations_read_model_never_expands_full_persona_fleet makes full-fleet expansion a test failure.

telemetry.before: Performance attribution and the Fleet list could call get_telemetry_summary once per runtime/persona.
telemetry.after: Each composition preloads list_telemetry_summaries once and indexes that bounded in-memory projection for its calculation when it contains canonical rows; only older no-list fixtures retain their historical record lookup.
telemetry.regression: test_attribution_reuses_bulk_telemetry_projection makes every per-runtime telemetry read a test failure.

data_sources.before: The async BFF handler synchronously waited for Source Ingest's registry read, inheriting its downstream latency.
data_sources.after: The handler uses a two-slot worker read and a 750ms production-default wait budget; timed-out or saturated reads return source=unavailable and an explicit reason.
data_sources.regression: test_data_sources_times_out_as_typed_unavailable_not_a_healthy_cache uses a 300ms registry read with a 50ms budget and requires a <=250ms typed unavailable endpoint envelope.

freshness_and_degradation.canonical_registry_authority: Source Ingest get_source_connector_registry remains the only registry read. No cache is introduced.
freshness_and_degradation.saturation: source=unavailable with reason=read_capacity_saturated; no late or prior connector list is labelled healthy.
freshness_and_degradation.late_worker_behavior: A synchronous worker cannot be forcibly cancelled after starting, so its slot remains reserved until completion. This prevents unbounded queued late work.

functional_budget.cockpit: One alerts build and one runtime-health build per Cockpit composition; no repeated downstream fan-out through Operator Home.
functional_budget.operations_persona: No 500-row fleet materialisation for an individual persona response.
functional_budget.fleet_and_attribution: One bulk telemetry-summary projection per composition, rather than N per-runtime reads when that projection is available; record lookup is legacy no-list compatibility only.
functional_budget.data_sources: 750ms production-default wait budget, two concurrently admitted reads, and a 250ms focused test envelope when the budget is configured to 50ms.
functional_budget.payload: Existing list page bounds and response schemas are retained; the single-persona operation no longer constructs the discarded full-list payload.

validation.environment: task-local Python 3.12 virtual environment; isolated ReadSurfaceStore fixtures; no provider credentials or live-capital authority used.

commands.result: 25 passed when run as the four focused suites (9 + 5 + 2 + 9).

three_sample_dev_smoke.required_after_deployment: For Cockpit, persona-fleet, and data-sources, take three authenticated read-only samples from the deployed task merge SHA; record elapsed time, serialized response bytes, status/source/degradation state, and the hosted deployment identity. Confirm unavailable Source Ingest remains unavailable rather than healthy-empty.

rollback.code: Revert this task's two commits together. The prior direct Source registry read resumes; no stored cache state, migration, or schema rollback exists.
rollback.operational: If a deployed registry-read budget is too restrictive, adjust PANTHEON_BFF_DATA_SOURCES_READ_TIMEOUT_SECONDS within the documented bounded behavior; unavailable remains explicit.
